properties.description: Border color of the shared field shell. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-flyout-background
properties.description: The background color of the panel. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-background)`.

properties.name: --esp-flyout-border
properties.description: The border on the panel's leading edge. Defaults to the tear-off perforation, `1px dotted var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-flyout-padding
properties.description: Padding inside the panel's header and content regions. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-padding)`.

properties.name: --esp-flyout-radius

properties.name: --esp-flyout-shadow
properties.description: The panel's shadow. Defaults to `none` in the gutter/docked modes (the perforation does the separating) and to a drawer shadow in overlay mode.

properties.name: --esp-flyout-z-index
properties.description: Stack order of the overlay-drawer mode. Defaults to `3000` — above page chrome, below the dialog drop zone (4000). Set it on the `esp-page` (or an ancestor), not on the flyout itself: the page reads the same token to hoist the drawer's aside above its header.

properties.description: Focal marker fill.

properties.name: --esp-focus-picker-marker-shadow
properties.description: Focal marker shadow.

properties.description: Always-emitted family for body and UI text. Defaults to `system-ui, sans-serif` when `fontBody` is omitted or empty.

properties.name: --esp-font-brand
properties.description: Consumer-authored brand family. Emitted only when configured; brand recipes otherwise fall back through headings to `--esp-font-body`.

properties.name: --esp-font-headings
properties.description: Consumer-authored heading family. Emitted only when configured; heading recipes otherwise fall back to `--esp-font-body`.

properties.name: --esp-font-monospace

properties.name: --esp-footer-background

properties.name: --esp-footer-background-blend-mode

properties.name: --esp-footer-background-image

properties.name: --esp-footer-background-image-opacity

properties.name: --esp-footer-background-position

properties.name: --esp-footer-background-repeat

properties.name: --esp-footer-background-size

properties.name: --esp-footer-brand-logo-size

properties.name: --esp-footer-content-lead
properties.description: Fraction of surplus placed before content (`0`, `0.5`, or `1`). Defaults to `0`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-content-max-width
properties.description: Surface-alignment cap published by `esp-page`. Defaults to `100%`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-focus-outline
properties.description: Focus-visible outline. Defaults to `2px solid var(--esp-color-link)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-heading-color
properties.description: Heading and configured-brand color. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-headings)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-link-color
properties.description: Link color. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-link)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-link-group-gap
properties.description: Space between a link-group heading and its links. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-small)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-link-group-min-width
properties.description: Intrinsic minimum link-group column width. Defaults to `10rem`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-link-hover-color
properties.description: Hovered link color. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-link-hover)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-padding-block
properties.description: Content block padding. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-padding-page)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-padding-inline
properties.description: Content inline padding. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-padding-page)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-row-gap
properties.description: Vertical gap between footer grid rows and link groups stacked in `esp-footer-column`. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-big)`.

properties.name: --esp-footer-section-gap
properties.description: Gap between media, primary, and bottom regions. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-big)`.

properties.name: --esp-header-brand-font-size

properties.name: --esp-header-brand-hover-decoration

properties.name: --esp-header-brand-hover-transform

properties.description: The color of the burger button when the menu is closed. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-headings)`.

properties.name: --esp-header-button-closed-hover-color
properties.description: The hover color of the burger button when the menu is closed. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-headings-hover)`.

properties.name: --esp-header-button-open-hover-color

properties.name: --esp-header-button-stroke-width

properties.name: --esp-header-compact-height

properties.name: --esp-header-content-max-width
properties.description: Surface-alignment contract set by `esp-page`: the maximum width the bar content is constrained to (the bar background stays full-bleed). Defaults to `100%` (no constraint). `esp-page` sets this to its resolved content cap.

properties.name: --esp-header-extended-menu-border
properties.description: The border between the primary row and second-row menu in extended layouts. Defaults to `1px solid var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-header-extended-menu-height
properties.description: The second-row menu height for extended layouts. Defaults to `calc(3.5 * var(--esp-size-small))`.

properties.name: --esp-header-height
properties.description: The height of the header bar. Defaults to `calc(4.5 * var(--esp-size-small))`.

properties.name: --esp-header-progress-background

properties.name: --esp-header-progress-height

properties.name: --esp-header-progress-track-background

properties.name: --esp-header-scrolled-shadow

properties.name: --esp-header-shadow

properties.name: --esp-header-topbar-height

properties.name: --esp-header-transparent-background

properties.name: --esp-header-z-index

properties.name: --esp-image-border

properties.name: --esp-image-border-radius

properties.name: --esp-image-compact-width

properties.name: --esp-image-duotone-highlight-color

properties.name: --esp-image-duotone-shadow-color

properties.name: --esp-image-object-position

properties.name: --esp-image-overlay-color

properties.name: --esp-image-overlay-padding

properties.name: --esp-image-overlay-text-shadow

properties.name: --esp-image-preview-border-color

properties.name: --esp-image-preview-overlay-text

properties.name: --esp-image-preview-remove-color

properties.name: --esp-image-scrim-color

properties.name: --esp-image-scrim-opacity

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-blend-mode

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-color

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-image

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-image-opacity

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-opacity

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-position

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-repeat
properties.description: Consumer texture repeat.

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-scale
properties.description: CSS-gradient texture pitch override.

properties.name: --esp-image-texture-size
properties.description: Consumer texture size.

properties.name: --esp-image-upload-preview-background
properties.description: The background color of the image preview area.

properties.name: --esp-info-color-background
properties.description: The background color of the info box.

properties.name: --esp-info-color-border

properties.name: --esp-info-color-text

properties.name: --esp-menu-border-color

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-hover-background

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-icon-min-width

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-icon-padding

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-icon-size

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-indicator-color

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-panel-background

properties.name: --esp-menu-group-panel-shadow

properties.name: --esp-menu-horizontal-justify-content

properties.description: Text color of the active item.

properties.name: --esp-menu-item-active-font-weight

properties.description: Border color.

properties.name: --esp-menu-item-icon-size

properties.name: --esp-menu-item-padding

properties.name: --esp-menu-scrim-color
properties.description: Scrim color when the drawer is open.

properties.name: --esp-menu-top-offset
properties.description: Top offset for drawers below fixed headers.

properties.name: --esp-page-background
properties.description: The background color of the page. Fills both the surface and the canvas gutters; the canvas tokens paint over it in the gutters only. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-background)`.

properties.name: --esp-page-background-image
properties.description: The background image to display behind page content. Defaults to `none`.

properties.name: --esp-page-background-image-opacity
properties.description: The opacity of the background image layer. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: --esp-page-canvas-background
properties.description: The background color of the canvas gutters (the outer regions revealed when the viewport exceeds the cap). Defaults to `transparent`, so gutters match the page until styled and narrow viewports are unaffected.

properties.name: --esp-page-canvas-background-image
properties.description: A background image for the canvas gutters, mirroring the page background-image knob. Defaults to `none`.

properties.name: --esp-page-canvas-background-image-opacity
properties.description: The opacity of the canvas gutter image layer. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: --esp-page-fixed-header-offset
properties.description: Offset reserved for fixed headers. Defaults to `var(--esp-header-height)`.

properties.name: --esp-page-flyout-default-width
properties.description: Initial automatic in-grid help target, clamped between the help minimum and maximum. When unset, the established flexible allocation remains in effect. A retained pointer or keyboard resize preference supersedes this target.

properties.name: --esp-page-flyout-max-width
properties.description: Maximum help width and overlay drawer cap before the `85vw` viewport cap. Defaults to `30rem`.

properties.name: --esp-page-flyout-min-width
properties.description: Minimum in-grid help width. Defaults to `20rem`.

properties.name: --esp-page-flyout-width
properties.description: Legacy fixed-width alias that pins both help bounds.

properties.name: --esp-page-header-z-index
properties.description: Z-index for fixed/sticky header regions. Defaults to `20`.

properties.name: --esp-page-main-background
properties.description: The background of the main content well. Defaults to `transparent` (the well shows the page background). Set it to give the content well its own card color, or pair the transparent default with `--esp-page-surface-shadow: none` for content that floats directly on the page with no frame.

properties.name: --esp-page-main-max-width
properties.description: Maximum width of the main content well. Defaults from `kind`: `1536px` (wide), `768px` (narrow), or unbounded (full). An explicit value overrides every kind default, including `full` — except `site`, whose main region is always unbounded because sections own their wells. Surplus width beyond it becomes canvas gutters.

properties.name: --esp-page-main-min-width
properties.description: Minimum width of the main content well while preview or in-grid help competes for space. Defaults to `30rem`.

properties.name: --esp-page-max-width
properties.description: Legacy fallback for `--esp-page-main-max-width`.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-background
properties.description: Background of the persistent preview surface. Defaults to the main background, then the page background.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-border
properties.description: Leading tear-off edge between main and preview. Defaults to `1px dotted var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-default-width
properties.description: Initial automatic preview target, clamped between the preview minimum and maximum. When unset, the established preview-first flexible allocation remains in effect. A retained pointer or keyboard resize preference supersedes this target.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-max-width
properties.description: Maximum preview width. Defaults to `48rem`. Preview receives flexible trailing space before help grows.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-min-main-width
properties.description: Legacy fallback for `--esp-page-main-min-width`.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-min-width
properties.description: Minimum preview width. Defaults to `22.5rem` (360px, a reasonable mobile-device surface).

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-shadow
properties.description: Shadow cast from the preview's trailing edge. Defaults to the page surface edge shadow. Set to `none` for a flat additive surface.

properties.name: --esp-page-preview-width
properties.description: Legacy fixed-width alias that pins both preview bounds.

properties.name: --esp-page-resize-focus-outline
properties.description: Keyboard-focus line drawn along the focused seam, spanning the visible dotted edge up to one viewport height. Defaults to `2px dashed var(--esp-color-link)`.

properties.name: --esp-page-resize-focus-shadow
properties.description: Glow cast by the focused seam line, in the line's color. Defaults to `0 0 0.75rem var(--esp-color-link)`.

properties.name: --esp-page-resize-handle-hit-size
properties.description: Transparent inline hit target centered on each dotted seam. Defaults to `2.75rem`.

properties.name: --esp-page-resize-large-step
properties.description: Shift+Arrow resize step. Defaults to `4rem`.

properties.name: --esp-page-resize-step
properties.description: Arrow-key resize step. Defaults to `1rem`.

properties.name: --esp-page-sticky-header-top
properties.description: Top inset for sticky headers. Defaults to `0`.

properties.name: --esp-page-surface-border
properties.description: An optional border on the inline edges of the surface, for themes preferring a hairline over a shadow. Defaults to `none` (e.g. `1px solid var(--esp-color-border)`). Combine with `--esp-page-surface-shadow: none` to switch the content frame from a drop shadow to a hairline, or turn both off for no frame.

properties.name: --esp-page-surface-shadow
properties.description: The box shadow drawn on the left and right edges of the content surface. On by default; casts into the gutters and is clipped away when the surface fills the viewport, so it only shows above the cap. Set to `none` to remove it.

properties.name: --esp-page-well-max-width
properties.description: The shared content-column width in `kind="site"`: the header and footer alignment contract and every `esp-section` well default to it. Defaults to `72rem`.

properties.name: --esp-progress-border-color
properties.description: Border color of the track outline. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-progress-border-radius
properties.description: Border radius of the track and fill. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-border-radius)`.

properties.name: --esp-progress-circle-size
properties.description: Diameter of the circular progress ring in circle mode. Automatically set by the `size` attribute.

properties.name: --esp-progress-fill-color
properties.description: Color of the progress fill. Defaults to the active action hue at the semantic muted lightness so the filled and unfilled portions remain distinguishable in light and dark themes.

properties.name: --esp-progress-font-size
properties.description: Font size for the value text. Defaults to `var(--esp-type-small)`.

properties.name: --esp-progress-height
properties.description: Height of the progress bar track. Automatically set by the `size` attribute.

properties.name: --esp-progress-text-color
properties.description: Color of the percentage text in both bar and circle modes. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-text)`.

properties.name: --esp-radio-button-focus-shadow
properties.description: The color of the focus ring shadow. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-shadow)`.

properties.name: --esp-radio-button-icon-color
properties.description: The stroke color of the radio icon. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-text)`.

properties.name: --esp-radio-button-size
properties.description: The width and height of the radio icon. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-normal-to-medium)`.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-background
properties.description: Background of the repeater container.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-border
properties.description: Border of the repeater container.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-border-radius
properties.description: Border radius of the repeater container.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-content-padding
properties.description: Padding inside the virtualized content region. Defaults to `0`.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-gap
properties.description: Space between repeated items.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-grid-column-gap
properties.description: Horizontal gap between grid columns.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-grid-columns
properties.description: Grid column count when `layout="grid"`. Supports media-query overrides.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-grid-row-gap
properties.description: Vertical gap between grid rows.

properties.name: --esp-repeater-padding
properties.description: Padding used by repeater state panels and the loading/error footer.

properties.name: --esp-row-gap
properties.description: Overrides the gap between children. Defaults to the `gap` attribute's step, `normal` when unset.

properties.name: --esp-search-active-background
properties.description: Background color of the active result row. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-layer-2)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-backdrop
properties.description: Backdrop color behind the panel. Defaults to `oklch(0.15 0 0 / 0.6)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-border-color
properties.description: Divider and loading-track color used by the search panel. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-highlight-background
properties.description: Background color applied to `<mark>` highlights inside excerpts.

properties.name: --esp-search-loading-indicator-color
properties.description: Accent color of the loading spinner. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-primary)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-loading-indicator-track-color
properties.description: Track color of the loading spinner. Defaults to `var(--esp-search-border-color)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-max-height
properties.description: Maximum height of the results list. Defaults to `60vh`.

properties.name: --esp-search-max-width
properties.description: Maximum width of the search panel. Defaults to `40rem`.

properties.name: --esp-search-muted-color
properties.description: Muted text color for placeholders, excerpts, and empty states.

properties.name: --esp-search-panel-background
properties.description: Background color of the search panel. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-layer-1)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-panel-shadow
properties.description: Box shadow of the search panel.

properties.name: --esp-search-text-color
properties.description: Main text color used by the search UI. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-text)`.

properties.name: --esp-search-title-color
properties.description: Title color for result rows. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-headings)`.

properties.name: --esp-section-background
properties.description: The band's background. Defaults to the local `--esp-color-background`, which inside a `context` zone is the zone's canvas.

properties.name: --esp-section-decoration-color
properties.description: Semantic tint applied through the mask. Defaults to the local `--esp-color-headings`.

properties.name: --esp-section-decoration-image
properties.description: Raster alpha mask painted behind the well. Defaults to `none`.

properties.name: --esp-section-decoration-opacity
properties.description: Decoration opacity from `0` through `1`. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: --esp-section-decoration-position
properties.description: Mask position, including responsive or bleeding values. Defaults to `center`.

properties.name: --esp-section-decoration-size
properties.description: Mask size. Defaults to `contain`.

properties.name: --esp-section-max-width
properties.description: The content well's cap. Defaults to `var(--esp-page-well-max-width, 72rem)`; `none` lets content span the band.

properties.name: --esp-section-padding-block
properties.description: Vertical rhythm above and below the well. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-section)`.

properties.name: --esp-section-padding-inline
properties.description: Horizontal breathing room inside the band at narrow viewports. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-medium)`.

properties.name: --esp-size-box-padding
properties.description: The padding inside the box.

properties.name: --esp-size-burger-stroke
properties.description: The stroke width of the burger lines.

properties.name: --esp-size-color-picker-border-width
properties.description: The border width of the color picker.

properties.name: --esp-slider-focus-shadow
properties.description: Color of the focus ring shadow. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-shadow)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-thumb-border-color
properties.description: Border color of the thumb. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-thumb-color

properties.name: --esp-slider-thumb-shadow
properties.description: Box shadow of the thumb. Defaults to `0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-thumb-size
properties.description: Diameter of the thumb. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-normal-to-medium)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-track-border-radius
properties.description: Border radius of the track. Defaults to `calc(var(--esp-slider-track-height, 6px) / 2)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-track-color
properties.description: Background color of the unfilled portion of the track. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-track-fill-color
properties.description: Background color of the filled portion of the track. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-action-background)`.

properties.name: --esp-slider-track-height
properties.description: Height of the slider track. Defaults to `6px`.

properties.name: --esp-stack-gap
properties.description: Overrides the gap between children. Defaults to the `gap` attribute's step, `normal` when unset.

properties.name: --esp-switch-focus-shadow
properties.description: The color of the focus ring shadow. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-shadow)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-height
properties.description: The height of the switch track. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-normal-to-medium)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-text-active-color
properties.description: Text color of the active label in text mode. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-action-text)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-text-font-size
properties.description: Font size for text-mode labels. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-font)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-text-highlight-color

properties.name: --esp-switch-text-inactive-color

properties.name: --esp-switch-text-padding

properties.name: --esp-switch-thumb-color
properties.description: The thumb color. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-layer-1)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-thumb-size
properties.description: The diameter of the thumb. Defaults to `calc(var(--esp-switch-height) - 4px)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-track-color
properties.description: The track background color when the switch is off. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-track-color-on
properties.description: The track background color when the switch is on. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-action-background)`.

properties.name: --esp-switch-width
properties.description: The width of the switch track. Defaults to `calc(var(--esp-size-normal-to-medium) * 1.75)`.

properties.name: --esp-tab-color-background
properties.description: Background color of the overall component.

properties.name: --esp-tab-color-border
properties.description: Border color of the tab group container.

properties.name: --esp-tab-color-button-active
properties.description: Active tab button background.

properties.name: --esp-tab-color-button-hover
properties.description: Tab button hover background.

properties.name: --esp-tab-color-strip-background
properties.description: Background color of the tab strip.

properties.name: --esp-tab-color-text
properties.description: Text color for tab buttons.

properties.name: --esp-tab-size-padding
properties.description: Padding inside the panel area.

properties.name: --esp-toaster-gap
properties.description: Gap between stacked toasts. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-tiny-to-small)`.

properties.name: --esp-toaster-padding
properties.description: Padding around the toaster container. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-padding)`.

properties.name: --esp-toaster-z-index
properties.description: Stack order of the toaster container. Defaults to `5000`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-background
properties.description: Background color of the tooltip. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-layer-1)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-border
properties.description: Border of the tooltip. Defaults to `1px solid var(--esp-color-border)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-border-radius
properties.description: Border radius of the tooltip. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-border-radius)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-color
properties.description: Text color inside the tooltip. Defaults to `var(--esp-color-text)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-focus-outline
properties.description: Outline used when the trigger receives keyboard focus. Defaults to `2px solid var(--esp-color-link)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-font-size
properties.description: Font size of tooltip text. Defaults to `var(--esp-type-small)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-max-width
properties.description: Maximum width of the tooltip. Defaults to `40ch`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-padding
properties.description: Padding inside the tooltip. Defaults to `var(--esp-size-tiny) var(--esp-size-small)`.

properties.name: --esp-tooltip-shadow
properties.description: Box shadow for the tooltip. Defaults to `2px 2px 4px var(--esp-color-shadow)`.

properties.name: --esp-tree-action-bg

properties.name: --esp-tree-action-hover-bg

properties.name: --esp-tree-icon-color

properties.description: Font weight for label text.

properties.name: --esp-type-label-letter-spacing
